Inlay op1 `DC` (female board): deepest cut 4.000 mm below the stock top, a flat floor at depth_mm 4.000 mm; V-bit floor ridges 0.400 mm along the rings and up to 0.800 mm at their corners where no clearing pass reaches.
Inlay op1 `DC` (male board): deepest cut 5.000 mm below the male board's top, the plug's start plane 3.000 mm below the male board's top and the surround's flat floor plug_depth_mm 2.000 mm below that; V-bit floor ridges 0.200 mm along the rings and up to 0.400 mm at their corners where no clearing pass reaches; band: drawn boundary i3, narrowest band 8.319 mm (open edge, edge pass t2); clearing pass `t2` cuts the band's outer edge upright, its inward curves rounded to 1.587 mm; the cut-out frees the plug along the floor's outer edge, its centre 1.587 mm inside the band's edge and at least 6.731 mm out from the design, through the board to 0.200 mm below it.
